vocabulary.meaning_en: during the whole period, from start to end (and maybe a little after)
to have no more time left
vocabulary.example: The test was hard, and I ran out of time.
We used up all our time on the first question.

vocabulary.meaning_en: given for a special purpose (time, money)
vocabulary.example: You have two hours of allotted time.

vocabulary.note_ar: around و at around بنفس المعنى تقريبًا
vocabulary.note_en: Around and at around mean almost the same.
vocabulary.example: I'll be at your house at around 4 o'clock.

vocabulary.meaning_en: close to the real number, but not exact
at some time inside a bigger period
vocabulary.example: He fell asleep during the meeting.
Please come ahead of the others; we need to talk.

vocabulary.meaning_en: from now until the end of a period of time
vocabulary.example: I'll be there within ten minutes.

vocabulary.meaning_en: after one time and before another time

vocabulary.example: Be here by the time the store closes.
The class starts at 9 on the dot.

vocabulary.meaning_en: almost too late, but not late
vocabulary.example: We got to the station just in time.
The baby fell asleep in the car.

fine_lines.title: throughout vs during
fine_lines.explanation_ar: throughout = طوال الفترة كلها من بدايتها إلى نهايتها. during = في وقت ما داخل الفترة (جزء منها).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Throughout = for the whole period, from start to end. During = at some time inside the period (a part of it).

examples.sentence: It rained throughout the night, until the morning.
It rained during the night. Now the ground is wet.

fine_lines.title: within vs between
fine_lines.explanation_ar: within = من الآن حتى نهاية مدة معينة (البداية هي الآن). between = بعد وقت معيّن وقبل وقت آخر، ولا علاقة لها بالآن.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Within = from now until the end of a time (the start is now). Between = after one time and before another; it has nothing to do with now.

examples.sentence: The ambulance will be there within ten minutes.
I'll be at your house between 4 and 5 p.m.

fine_lines.title: on the dot vs just in time
fine_lines.explanation_ar: on the dot = في الموعد بالضبط. just in time = في آخر لحظة قبل فوات الأوان.
fine_lines.explanation_en: On the dot = exactly on time. Just in time = at the last moment before it is too late.

examples.sentence: He arrived at 5 o'clock on the dot.
I ran and caught the door just in time.

expressions.example: I couldn't finish the test. I ran out of time.

expressions.phrase: I'll be there within ten minutes.
expressions.meaning_ar: سأكون هناك في غضون عشر دقائق.
expressions.meaning_en: From now, in ten minutes or less.
expressions.example: Don't worry, I'll be there within ten minutes.
The bus leaves at 9 o'clock on the dot.
We got there just in time for the plane.

grammar.title: Period words: throughout, during, within, between
grammar.explanation_ar: throughout + فترة = طوالها. during + فترة = في وقت ما خلالها. within + مدة = من الآن حتى نهايتها. between + وقت and + وقت = بين وقتين.
grammar.explanation_en: throughout + period = the whole time. during + period = at some time inside it. within + length of time = from now to the end. between + time and + time = between two times.
examples: The shop is busy throughout the year.
Please don't talk during the exam.

grammar.title: Approximate time: (at) around / (at) about
grammar.explanation_ar: around أو about أو at around أو at about + وقت = وقت تقريبي، وكلها صحيحة بنفس المعنى تقريبًا.
grammar.explanation_en: around / about / at around / at about + time = an approximate time. All are correct with almost the same meaning.

grammar.title: Early, late and exact
grammar.explanation_ar: ahead of = مبكرًا (قبل). run out of time = لم يبقَ وقت. by the time = قبل (لا بعد). on the dot = بالضبط. just in time = في آخر لحظة.
grammar.explanation_en: ahead of = early (before). run out of time = no time left. by the time = before (not after). on the dot = exactly. just in time = at the last moment.
examples: By the time the store closes, be here.
The meeting began at 10 on the dot.

questions.question: They should be here ___ 5 and 6 p.m.
James fell asleep ___ the meeting.
questions.explanation_en: In part of the meeting: during.

questions.question: The rain went on ___ the night, right up until the early morning.
questions.explanation_en: The whole night until morning: throughout.

questions.question: The test was very difficult, and I ___ time.
questions.explanation_ar: لم يبقَ وقت: ran out of.
questions.explanation_en: No time left: ran out of.

questions.question: The ambulance will be there ___ ten minutes. (starting now)
"Come ahead of the others" means come ___.
"I'll be there at around 4." The time is ___.
The simplest meaning of "by the time" is ___.
"We caught the train just in time." means ___.
choices: We arrived at the last moment.
